name: push_up
description: A classic bodyweight pushing exercise that builds chest, shoulder, and tricep strength while engaging the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, keeping elbows at a 45-degree angle from your body.
Press back up to the starting position, maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your core braced throughout the movement.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike upward.
Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees, stressing the shoulder joint.
Not reaching full lockout at the top of the movement.

name: diamond_push_up
description: A push-up variation with hands close together forming a diamond shape, placing greater emphasis on the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching to form a diamond shape.
Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping elbows close to your sides.
Press back up to full arm extension.
Keep your body in a rigid straight line throughout.
commonMistakes: Allowing the hips to sag or rise during the movement.
Letting elbows flare outward instead of tracking back along the torso.

name: pike_push_up
description: A push-up variation performed in a pike position that shifts load to the shoulders, mimicking an overhead press.
instructions: Start in a downward-dog position with hips raised high and body forming an inverted V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up by extending your elbows, returning to the pike position.
Keep feet hip-width apart and core engaged throughout.
commonMistakes: Not maintaining a high enough hip position, reducing shoulder engagement.
Letting the elbows flare out excessively rather than tracking slightly back.

name: dips_on_chair
description: A tricep-focused dip performed with hands placed on the edge of a chair or bench, suitable for home workouts.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the chair with legs extended or bent at 90 degrees.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press through your palms to return to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Allowing the shoulders to shrug up toward the ears at the bottom.
Bending the elbows outward instead of tracking them straight back.

name: incline_push_up
description: A beginner-friendly push-up variation performed with hands elevated on a surface, reducing the percentage of bodyweight lifted.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench, step, or countertop, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Walk your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the surface by bending your elbows.
Push back up to full arm extension.
commonMistakes: Sagging the hips, which removes core engagement.
Using a surface that is too low, making the movement too similar to a flat push-up before you are ready.

name: superman
description: A prone bodyweight exercise that strengthens the posterior chain, particularly the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor as high as comfortable.
Hold briefly at the top, squeezing your glutes and back muscles.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Holding the breath instead of breathing steadily.
Jerking the body up rather than lifting with controlled muscle contraction.

name: bodyweight_squat
description: A fundamental lower-body exercise that builds quad, glute, and hamstring strength with no equipment.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
commonMistakes: Letting the knees cave inward during the descent or ascent.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom of the squat.
Rising onto the toes instead of keeping heels grounded.

name: reverse_lunge
description: A unilateral lower-body exercise that targets the quads and glutes while improving balance and hip stability.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or at your sides.
Step one foot straight back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and chest upright.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
commonMistakes: Letting the front knee drift past the toes, increasing joint stress.
Leaning the torso forward instead of staying upright.

name: glute_bridge
description: A floor-based hip extension exercise that isolates the glutes and strengthens the posterior chain.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Hold at the top for one to two seconds, maintaining glute contraction.
Lower your hips back to the floor with control.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending the lower back instead of using the glutes to drive the movement.
Letting the knees collapse inward at the top of the bridge.

name: step_up
description: A unilateral lower-body exercise using a step or bench that builds quad and glute strength while improving balance.
instructions: Stand facing a step or bench that is roughly knee height.
Place one foot fully on the step and drive through that heel to lift your body up.
Bring the trailing foot up to stand on the step, then step back down with control.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.
commonMistakes: Pushing off the back foot instead of driving purely through the front leg.
Letting the front knee cave inward as you step up.

name: calf_raise
description: An isolation exercise for the calf muscles performed by rising onto the toes from a standing position.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Slowly rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower your heels back to the floor with control.
For added range, perform on the edge of a step.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the movement without achieving full range of motion.
Rolling the ankles outward instead of rising straight up.

name: lateral_lunge
description: A side-to-side lunge that targets the inner thighs and glutes while improving hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Take a wide step to one side and sink your hips back and down over that foot, keeping the opposite leg straight.
Push through the bent leg's heel to return to the starting position.
Alternate sides each rep.
commonMistakes: Allowing the stepping knee to cave inward.
Leaning the torso too far forward instead of sitting the hips back.

name: plank
description: An isometric core exercise that builds stability and endurance throughout the entire trunk.
instructions: Place forearms on the floor with elbows directly under shoulders, hands flat or clasped.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag, placing stress on the lower back.
Piking the hips upward, reducing core activation.
Holding the breath instead of breathing throughout the hold.

name: dead_bug
description: A supine core stability exercise that trains anti-extension strength while improving coordination.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Brace your core to press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly lower one arm overhead and extend the opposite leg simultaneously.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch away from the floor as limbs extend.
Moving too quickly and losing spinal stability.

name: bicycle_crunch
description: A dynamic core exercise that targets the obliques and rectus abdominis through a rotational cycling motion.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and knees bent at 90 degrees off the floor.
Bring one knee toward your chest while rotating the opposite elbow toward it.
Simultaneously extend the other leg out straight.
Alternate sides in a controlled, smooth cycling motion.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands instead of using the core to rotate.
Rushing the movement and losing rotational range.

name: mountain_climber
description: A dynamic full-body exercise combining core stability with cardio, performed from a high plank position.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with wrists under shoulders and body in a straight line.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then quickly switch legs.
Keep your hips low and level throughout the movement.
Maintain a braced core and steady breathing.
commonMistakes: Allowing the hips to bounce up with each knee drive.
Placing the hands too far forward, which shifts weight away from the core.

name: hollow_hold
description: An advanced isometric core exercise that builds deep abdominal strength and body tension.
instructions: Lie on your back and press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Raise your legs to about 30-45 degrees and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Extend your arms overhead, keeping them close to your ears.
Hold this banana-shaped position, breathing steadily.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor, indicating the core is not braced enough.
Raising the legs too high, which reduces the difficulty and core challenge.

name: dumbbell_shoulder_press
description: A seated or standing overhead pressing movement that builds shoulder size and strength.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells directly overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the weights back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your core braced and avoid arching the lower back.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back excessively to compensate for tight shoulders.
Pressing the dumbbells at an angle rather than straight overhead.

name: dumbbell_row
description: A unilateral pulling exercise that develops upper back, lat, and bicep strength.
instructions: Place one hand and same-side knee on a bench for support, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length with a neutral grip.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, driving the elbow straight back.
Lower the dumbbell under control and repeat for all reps before switching sides.
commonMistakes: Rotating the torso to generate momentum instead of pulling with the back.
Pulling the dumbbell toward the chest rather than the hip, reducing lat engagement.

name: dumbbell_curl
description: An isolation exercise for the biceps performed with dumbbells in a standing or seated position.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended and palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows tucked at your sides, curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Lower the weights slowly back to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso to help lift the weight, taking tension off the biceps.
Letting the elbows drift forward during the curl.

name: dumbbell_lateral_raise
description: A shoulder isolation exercise that targets the medial deltoid by raising dumbbells out to the sides.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing inward.
With a slight bend in the elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top with a slight forward tilt of the dumbbells.
Lower the weights slowly back to your sides.
commonMistakes: Using too much weight and swinging the body to initiate the lift.
Shrugging the shoulders up rather than lifting through the arms.

name: goblet_squat
description: A squat variation holding a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height that promotes an upright torso and deep squat mechanics.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically by one end at chest height, elbows pointing down.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly outward.
Squat down until your elbows touch the inside of your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
commonMistakes: Letting the torso lean forward excessively rather than staying upright.
Knees caving inward at the bottom of the squat.

name: dumbbell_rdl
description: A hip hinge movement with dumbbells that targets the hamstrings and glutes through a controlled lowering phase.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with a neutral grip.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back, and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and a flat back throughout.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back as the dumbbells descend.
Bending the knees too much, turning the movement into a squat.

name: dumbbell_split_squat
description: A unilateral lunge-pattern exercise with dumbbells that develops single-leg strength and stability.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step one foot forward and one foot back into a staggered stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your front shin vertical.
Keep your torso upright and core braced throughout.
Press through your front heel to return to the top position.
commonMistakes: Placing the feet too close together, causing balance issues.
Letting the front knee track inward rather than staying over the second toe.

name: arm_circles
description: A dynamic shoulder warm-up exercise that increases blood flow and mobility in the shoulder joint.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small forward circles gradually increasing to large circles.
After 15 seconds, reverse the direction.
Keep your posture tall and core lightly engaged.
commonMistakes: Tensing the shoulders and neck instead of staying relaxed.
Skipping the direction reversal, which limits full shoulder mobility.

name: leg_swings
description: A dynamic lower-body warm-up that mobilizes the hip joint through forward-back and lateral swinging motions.
instructions: Stand on one leg, holding a wall or sturdy surface for balance.
Swing the free leg forward and back in a controlled arc, gradually increasing range.
After 15 seconds, switch to lateral swings across the body.
Repeat on the other leg.
commonMistakes: Swinging too aggressively before the hip is warmed up.
Allowing the standing hip to shift rather than staying stable.

name: cat_cow
description: A gentle spinal mobility exercise performed on all fours that warms up the spine and core.
instructions: Begin on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale as you drop your belly toward the floor and lift your head and tailbone (cow).
Exhale as you round your spine toward the ceiling and tuck your chin and pelvis (cat).
Flow between positions slowly, coordinating movement with your breath.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the movement without using the breath to guide it.
Moving only through the lower back rather than mobilizing the entire spine.

name: childs_pose
description: A restorative yoga stretch that releases tension in the lower back, hips, and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel on a mat, sit your hips back toward your heels, and extend your arms forward on the floor.
Lower your chest and forehead toward the ground.
Breathe deeply and allow your hips and lower back to relax with each exhale.
Hold the position for the full duration.
commonMistakes: Holding the breath instead of using deep breathing to deepen the stretch.
Not sitting the hips far enough back, reducing the stretch in the lower back.

name: standing_quad_stretch
description: A standing stretch targeting the quadriceps, performed by pulling one foot toward the glutes.
instructions: Stand on one foot, using a wall for balance if needed.
Bend the other knee and grasp the ankle or foot behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold for the full duration, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Letting the knee of the stretching leg flare outward rather than pointing straight down.
Leaning forward at the hips instead of standing tall.

name: seated_hamstring_stretch
description: A floor-based stretch that targets the hamstrings, performed from a seated forward-fold position.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs extended straight in front of you.
Sit tall and hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Hold the position when you feel a comfortable stretch in the back of your thighs.
Breathe deeply and try to lengthen your spine with each inhale.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back from the upper spine rather than hinging from the hips.
Forcing the stretch by pulling aggressively, which can cause the hamstrings to tighten as a protective response.

name: wall_push_up
description: A beginner-friendly push-up performed against a wall, building foundational pushing strength.
instructions: Stand arm's length from a wall with hands at shoulder height.
Bend elbows to bring chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start, keeping body straight.
Maintain a tight core throughout.
commonMistakes: Standing too close to the wall.

name: wide_push_up
description: A push-up variation with hands placed wider than shoulder width, emphasizing the chest.
instructions: Place hands about 1.5x shoulder width apart.
Lower chest to the floor, elbows flaring at about 60 degrees.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep core braced and body straight.
commonMistakes: Hands too wide causing shoulder strain.

name: archer_push_up
description: A unilateral push-up variation where one arm extends to the side while the other does the work.
instructions: Start in a wide push-up position.
Shift weight to one arm and lower toward that hand.
The other arm extends straight to the side.
Push back up and alternate sides.
commonMistakes: Not shifting weight enough to the working arm.

name: pseudo_planche_push_up
description: A push-up with hands positioned near the hips and body leaning forward, loading the shoulders heavily.
instructions: Place hands by your hips with fingers pointing sideways.
Lean forward until shoulders are ahead of hands.
Lower chest toward the ground maintaining the lean.
Push back up keeping core engaged.

name: one_arm_push_up
description: An advanced push-up performed with a single arm, demanding extreme pressing strength and core stability.
instructions: Take a wide stance for balance.
Place one hand under your chest, other behind back.
Lower chest to the floor while resisting rotation.
Press back up with control.

name: planche_lean_push_up
description: A highly advanced push-up with an extreme forward lean, approaching planche position.
instructions: Start in a push-up position and lean far forward.
Keep arms straight or slightly bent, shoulders well past hands.
Perform a push-up while maintaining the forward lean.
Control the descent and ascent evenly.

name: decline_push_up
description: A push-up with feet elevated, shifting more load to the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place feet on an elevated surface, hands on the floor.
Lower chest toward the ground.
Press back up maintaining a straight body line.
Keep core tight throughout.
commonMistakes: Elevating the surface too high for current strength.

name: wall_handstand_hold
description: An isometric hold in a handstand position against a wall, building shoulder stability.
instructions: Kick up to a handstand facing the wall or with back to the wall.
Keep arms locked out and shoulders engaged.
Hold position with body straight.
Come down with control.

name: elevated_pike_push_up
description: A pike push-up with feet on an elevated surface, increasing shoulder loading.
instructions: Place feet on a bench or step, hips high in pike position.
Lower head toward the floor by bending elbows.
Press back up to full extension.
Maintain high hip angle throughout.

name: wall_handstand_push_up
description: A handstand push-up performed against a wall for support, building overhead pressing strength.
instructions: Kick up to a wall handstand.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up to full lockout.
Keep core tight and legs together.
commonMistakes: Kicking up with too much momentum.

name: deficit_handstand_push_up
description: A wall handstand push-up with hands on elevated surfaces for increased range of motion.
instructions: Place parallettes or blocks near a wall.
Kick up to a handstand on the blocks.
Lower past hand level for extra depth.
Press back up to lockout.

name: handstand_negative
description: A slow controlled descent from handstand, building eccentric overhead strength.
instructions: Kick up to a wall handstand.
Slowly lower the top of your head to the floor over 5 seconds.
Kick back up or come down and reset.
Focus on controlled descent.

name: freestanding_handstand_push_up
description: A handstand push-up without wall support, requiring elite strength and balance.
instructions: Kick up to a freestanding handstand.
Slowly lower head toward the floor.
Press back up while maintaining balance.
Keep core extremely tight.

name: ninety_degree_push_up
description: An ultra-advanced bent-arm press from an L-sit or planche position.
instructions: Start in an L-sit or tuck planche on the floor.
Lower body by bending arms to 90 degrees.
Press back up to the starting position.
Maintain hollow body throughout.
commonMistakes: Losing the tuck or L position.

name: dead_hang
description: A passive hang from a bar, building grip strength and shoulder mobility.
instructions: Grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Relax the shoulders and let them elevate slightly.
Hold for the prescribed duration.
commonMistakes: Gripping too tight causing forearm fatigue.

name: scapular_pull_up
description: A small-range pull-up focusing on scapular retraction and depression from a dead hang.
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms extended.
Without bending elbows, pull shoulder blades down and together.
Rise slightly as scapulae engage.
Slowly return to dead hang.

name: band_assisted_pull_up
description: A pull-up with a resistance band looped around the bar to reduce bodyweight load.
instructions: Loop a resistance band over the bar.
Place one knee or foot in the band.
Perform a full pull-up with band assistance.
Lower with control.
commonMistakes: Using too thick a band for too long.
Not achieving full range of motion.

name: negative_pull_up
description: A pull-up focusing on the eccentric lowering phase, building strength for full pull-ups.
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Slowly lower yourself over 3-5 seconds.
Fully extend arms at the bottom.
Repeat from the top.
commonMistakes: Not fully extending at the bottom.

name: chin_up
description: A pull-up with palms facing you, emphasizing the biceps while working the back.
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Keep core engaged to avoid swinging.
commonMistakes: Not reaching full extension at the bottom.

name: pull_up
description: The classic overhand pull-up, a foundational upper body pulling exercise.
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing away, slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Lower with control to dead hang.
Avoid kipping or swinging.
commonMistakes: Not achieving full range of motion.

name: wide_pull_up
description: A pull-up with hands placed wider than shoulder width, emphasizing the lats.
instructions: Grip the bar with hands well outside shoulder width.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Lower with control to full extension.
Focus on driving elbows down and back.
commonMistakes: Grip too wide causing shoulder impingement.

name: l_sit_pull_up
description: A pull-up performed with legs held straight in an L-sit position, adding core demand.
instructions: Hang from the bar and raise legs to an L position.
Maintain the L-sit while performing a pull-up.
Lower with control keeping legs elevated.
Return to L-sit dead hang.

name: muscle_up
description: An advanced bar movement combining a pull-up with a dip transition above the bar.
instructions: Start from a dead hang with a slight false grip.
Pull explosively, transitioning elbows above the bar.
Press up to full lockout above the bar.
Lower back with control.
commonMistakes: Not pulling high enough before transition.

name: typewriter_pull_up
description: An advanced pull-up where you pull to one side at the top, then traverse to the other.
instructions: Pull up to chin level.
Shift laterally to one arm at the top.
Traverse to the other side while staying above the bar.
Lower with control and repeat.
commonMistakes: Not pulling high enough to traverse.

name: band_pull_apart
description: A posterior chain exercise pulling a resistance band apart at chest height.
instructions: Hold a band at chest height with arms extended.
Pull the band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Keep arms straight throughout.

name: prone_y_raise
description: A floor exercise raising arms in a Y pattern to strengthen the lower traps and rear delts.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y shape.
Raise arms off the floor by squeezing the upper back.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
commonMistakes: Lifting too high and using lower back.

name: inverted_row_high
description: A bodyweight row performed under a high bar at an easy angle.
instructions: Set a bar at waist to chest height.
Hang underneath with arms extended and body straight.
Pull chest to the bar by driving elbows back.
Lower with control.

name: inverted_row
description: A bodyweight row under a low bar, creating a more horizontal body angle for greater difficulty.
instructions: Set a bar at knee height.
Hang underneath with body straight, heels on the floor.
Pull chest to the bar.
Lower with control.
commonMistakes: Not fully extending arms at the bottom.

name: ring_row
description: An inverted row on gymnastic rings, adding instability for greater muscle recruitment.
instructions: Set rings at an appropriate height.
Hang underneath with arms extended.
Pull chest to the rings, squeezing shoulder blades.
Control the descent against the ring instability.

name: archer_inverted_row
description: A unilateral inverted row where one arm extends while the other pulls.
instructions: Set up under a bar in an inverted row position.
Pull to one side while the other arm extends straight.
Lower with control and alternate sides.
Keep body rigid throughout.
commonMistakes: Not extending the assist arm fully.

name: tuck_front_lever_row
description: A horizontal row from a tuck front lever position on a bar.
instructions: Hang from the bar and bring knees to chest in a tuck.
Lever body horizontal while maintaining the tuck.
Row body up toward the bar.
Lower with control.

name: front_lever_row
description: A rowing motion from a full front lever position, an elite gymnastic pulling skill.
instructions: Achieve a full front lever hang.
Pull body up toward the bar while maintaining lever position.
Lower back to full extension.
Keep body completely straight.

name: one_arm_inverted_row
description: An inverted row performed with a single arm, demanding extreme pulling strength.
instructions: Set up under a bar or ring with one arm.
Keep body straight and pull chest to the bar.
Lower with control, resisting rotation.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: sumo_squat
description: A wide-stance squat emphasizing the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width, toes turned out.
Lower hips until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through the heels to stand.
Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes.

name: jump_squat
description: An explosive squat variation adding a jump at the top for power development.
instructions: Perform a bodyweight squat.
Explode upward from the bottom, jumping as high as possible.
Land softly with bent knees.
Immediately descend into the next rep.

name: cossack_squat
description: A deep single-leg squat to the side with the other leg extended straight.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Shift weight to one leg and squat deep on that side.
Keep the other leg straight with heel on the floor.
Rise and alternate sides.
commonMistakes: Heel lifting on the squatting leg.

name: shrimp_squat
description: A single-leg squat holding the back foot behind you, requiring balance and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg, grab the other foot behind you.
Squat down on the standing leg until the back knee touches the floor.
Stand back up with control.
Keep torso upright.

name: sissy_squat
description: A quad-dominant squat where the knees travel far forward while leaning back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto toes, lean torso backward, and bend knees forward.
Lower until upper and lower legs form a sharp angle.
Drive back up through the quads.
commonMistakes: Not maintaining a straight line from knees to head.

name: pistol_squat
description: A full single-leg squat with the non-working leg held straight in front.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Squat all the way down while keeping the front leg elevated.
Stand back up without assistance.
Keep arms forward for balance.

name: dragon_squat
description: An advanced single-leg squat with the free leg crossing behind, adding rotation and balance demands.
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Cross the free leg behind the standing leg.
Squat down while maintaining balance.
Stand back up with control.
commonMistakes: Not crossing the leg far enough behind.

name: hip_hinge_drill
description: A fundamental movement pattern drill teaching proper hip hinge mechanics.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, slight knee bend.
Push hips back while keeping spine neutral.
Lower torso until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward to return to standing.

name: single_leg_glute_bridge
description: A glute bridge performed on one leg, doubling the load on the working glute.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor, other leg elevated.
Drive through the planted foot to raise hips.
Squeeze glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

name: good_morning_bodyweight
description: A standing hip hinge with hands behind the head, stretching and strengthening the posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands behind head.
Hinge at hips, pushing them backward.
Lower torso until nearly parallel to the floor.
Drive hips forward to stand.

name: single_leg_rdl
description: A unilateral hip hinge standing on one leg, challenging balance and posterior chain strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hip, extending the free leg behind you.
Lower torso until nearly parallel to the floor.
Drive through the standing leg to return upright.

name: hip_thrust
description: A glute-dominant hinge with upper back on an elevated surface, maximizing hip extension load.
instructions: Sit on the floor with upper back against a bench.
Drive through heels to raise hips to full extension.
Squeeze glutes hard at the top.
Lower hips with control.

name: nordic_curl
description: An advanced hamstring exercise lowering the body from a kneeling position using eccentric control.
instructions: Kneel with feet anchored under a secure object.
Slowly lean forward, controlling the descent with hamstrings.
Lower as far as possible while maintaining control.
Push off the floor to assist returning up if needed.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips instead of the knees.

name: natural_glute_ham_raise
description: An elite posterior chain exercise performing a full eccentric and concentric hamstring curl from kneeling.
instructions: Kneel with feet anchored securely.
Lower body forward with control, keeping hips extended.
At the bottom, use hamstrings to curl body back up.
Maintain a straight line from knees to head throughout.

name: split_squat
description: A stationary lunge position squat, building unilateral leg strength.
instructions: Step one foot forward and one back into a lunge stance.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel to rise.
Keep torso upright.
commonMistakes: Front knee traveling too far past toes.

name: assisted_lunge
description: A forward lunge using a wall or surface for balance support.
instructions: Stand near a wall or sturdy surface for support.
Step forward into a lunge, lightly touching the wall for balance.
Lower until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Push back to standing.
commonMistakes: Relying too heavily on the support.

name: walking_lunge
description: A dynamic lunge where each step moves forward, building coordination and leg endurance.
instructions: Step forward into a lunge.
Drive through the front heel and step the back foot forward.
Continue alternating legs while walking forward.
Keep torso upright throughout.
commonMistakes: Taking steps that are too short.

name: deficit_reverse_lunge
description: A reverse lunge stepping back off an elevated surface, increasing the range of motion.
instructions: Stand on a low step or platform.
Step one foot back and down, lowering into a deep lunge.
Drive through the front heel to return to the platform.
Keep torso upright.

name: curtsy_lunge
description: A lunge stepping behind and across the body, targeting the glute medius.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot behind and across the other leg.
Lower into a lunge, keeping torso upright.
Drive through the front heel to return.

name: jumping_lunge
description: An explosive plyometric lunge switching legs in mid-air.
instructions: Start in a lunge position.
Jump explosively, switching legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Immediately jump into the next rep.

name: skater_squat
description: A single-leg squat variant where the free leg extends behind, like a skating motion.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg floating behind.
Squat down until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Stand back up using only the front leg.
Keep torso slightly forward for balance.

name: plank_shoulder_tap
description: From a plank position, alternately tap each shoulder while resisting rotation.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with feet wide.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return hand to the floor and repeat on the other side.
Keep hips level throughout.
commonMistakes: Rocking the hips side to side.

name: farmer_walk_band
description: A loaded carry walking while holding resistance bands at your sides.
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the ends at your sides.
Walk forward with good posture.
Keep shoulders down and core braced.
Walk for the prescribed distance or time.

name: bear_crawl
description: Crawling forward on hands and feet with knees hovering just above the ground.
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering 1 inch off the ground.
Move the opposite hand and foot forward simultaneously.
Keep hips level and back flat.
Crawl for the prescribed distance.

name: overhead_carry_band
description: Walking with a resistance band held overhead, challenging shoulder stability and core.
instructions: Press a resistance band overhead with both hands.
Walk forward while keeping arms locked out.
Maintain core bracing and avoid leaning.
Walk for the prescribed distance.

name: crab_walk
description: Walking in a tabletop position with belly facing up, building shoulder and hip endurance.
instructions: Sit on the floor, place hands behind you, feet flat.
Raise hips off the ground into a tabletop position.
Walk forward by moving opposite hand and foot.
Keep hips elevated throughout.
commonMistakes: Moving too quickly and losing form.

name: suitcase_carry_band
description: A single-side loaded carry holding a resistance band in one hand, demanding anti-lateral-flexion.
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with one foot, hold the end in one hand.
Walk forward while resisting the lateral pull.
Keep torso perfectly upright.
Switch sides halfway through.

name: alligator_walk
description: A crawling plank with a push-up at each step, combining locomotion with pressing.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, then crawl forward one hand and foot at a time.
Perform another push-up and continue.
Keep hips level throughout.

name: single_arm_overhead_carry
description: Walking with one arm locked out overhead holding a band, maximizing anti-lateral-flexion demand.
instructions: Press a resistance band overhead with one hand.
Walk forward while keeping the arm locked out.
Resist leaning to the side.
Switch arms at the halfway point.
commonMistakes: Leaning away from the overhead arm.

name: bird_dog
description: A quadruped exercise extending opposite arm and leg to train anti-extension and coordination.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend the right arm forward and left leg backward simultaneously.
Hold briefly, keeping hips level.
Return and switch sides.

name: kneeling_plank
description: A plank performed from the knees, reducing the lever arm for beginners.
instructions: Start face down with forearms on the floor.
Lift torso off the ground, keeping knees down.
Maintain a straight line from head to knees.
Hold for the prescribed duration.
commonMistakes: Looking up instead of straight down.

name: extended_plank
description: A plank with hands placed further forward, increasing the anti-extension demand.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Walk elbows forward a few inches past your shoulders.
Hold the position with core braced.
Maintain a straight body line.

name: body_saw
description: A dynamic plank variation rocking forward and backward to increase anti-extension challenge.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with sliders or towel under feet.
Rock body backward by pushing through forearms.
Pull body forward, extending past start position.
Maintain a rigid core throughout.

name: long_lever_plank
description: A plank with arms fully extended overhead, creating the longest possible lever arm.
instructions: Lie face down and extend arms overhead on the floor.
Lift into a plank position with arms extended.
Hold with core maximally braced.
Maintain a straight line from hands to feet.

name: dragon_flag
description: An advanced core exercise made famous by Bruce Lee, lowering and raising the body from a bench anchor.
instructions: Lie on your back, grip a sturdy object behind your head.
Raise entire body up so only upper back contacts the surface.
Slowly lower body toward the ground, keeping it straight.
Stop just above the ground and raise back up.

name: ring_body_saw
description: A body saw performed with feet in rings, adding instability for an extreme anti-extension challenge.
instructions: Place feet in gymnastic rings, arms in plank position.
Rock body forward and backward.
Fight the instability of the rings with core bracing.
Maintain straight body alignment.

name: crunch
description: A basic abdominal flexion exercise lifting the upper back off the floor.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Place hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl upper back off the floor, contracting the abs.
Lower with control.

name: lying_knee_tuck
description: A supine exercise bringing the knees to the chest, working the lower abdominals.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs extended.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Extend legs back out with control.

name: reverse_crunch
description: An abdominal exercise lifting the hips off the floor by curling the pelvis upward.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees.
Curl the hips off the floor, bringing knees toward your chest.
Lower the hips with control.
Keep upper back on the floor.

name: v_up
description: A full-body crunch bringing hands and feet together at the top.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously raise legs and upper body, reaching hands to toes.
Form a V shape at the top.
Lower back down with control.

name: lying_leg_raise
description: A supine exercise raising straight legs off the floor, targeting the lower abdominals.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight.
Place hands under your glutes for lower back support.
Raise legs to 90 degrees while keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.

name: toe_touch_crunch
description: A crunch reaching toward elevated feet for a full abdominal contraction.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised straight up to 90 degrees.
Reach hands toward your toes, lifting upper back off the floor.
Squeeze abs at the top.
Lower upper back with control.
commonMistakes: Only reaching with the arms, not crunching.

name: hanging_knee_raise
description: A hanging core exercise bringing the knees to the chest while hanging from a bar.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms extended.
Raise knees toward your chest by curling the pelvis.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

name: pike_crunch
description: A challenging crunch folding the body into a pike position from a lying start.
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously raise legs and torso, reaching hands past toes.
Fold into a tight pike at the top.
Lower with control.

name: hanging_leg_raise
description: An advanced hanging exercise raising straight legs to bar height.
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms extended.
Raise straight legs until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control, avoiding swing.

name: toes_to_bar
description: An elite hanging core exercise touching the toes to the bar at the top of each rep.
instructions: Hang from a bar with full extension.
Raise straight legs all the way up until toes touch the bar.
Lower with control to full extension.
Avoid excessive swinging.
commonMistakes: Using kip instead of strict form.

name: dead_bug_twist
description: A dead bug variation adding rotational movement as opposite limbs extend.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms raised and knees at 90 degrees.
Extend opposite arm and leg while rotating torso slightly.
Return to center and switch sides.
Keep lower back pressed into the floor.
commonMistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.

name: seated_twist
description: A seated rotational exercise turning the torso side to side.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat.
Lean back slightly and clasp hands together.
Rotate torso to one side, then the other.
Keep core engaged throughout.
commonMistakes: Rotating from the shoulders instead of the torso.

name: russian_twist
description: A seated rotational exercise with feet elevated, twisting side to side.
instructions: Sit with knees bent, lean back, lift feet off the floor.
Clasp hands together and rotate torso to one side.
Touch hands near the floor beside your hip.
Rotate to the other side.
commonMistakes: Only moving the arms, not the torso.
advancementCriteria: 3x15 each side with feet off floor

name: woodchop_band
description: A standing rotational exercise using a band anchored low or high, mimicking a chopping motion.
instructions: Anchor a band at a low or high point.
Stand sideways to the anchor, grip the band with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull band diagonally across body.
Control the return to the start.
commonMistakes: Using arms instead of torso rotation.

name: plank_rotation
description: A plank with a full torso rotation reaching one arm to the ceiling.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Rotate body to one side, reaching the top arm to the ceiling.
Hold briefly in a side plank position.
Return to plank and repeat on the other side.

name: windshield_wiper
description: A supine rotational exercise lowering straight legs from side to side.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended out to the sides.
Raise legs to 90 degrees.
Lower legs to one side, keeping shoulders on the floor.
Return to center and repeat to the other side.

name: hanging_windshield_wiper
description: An advanced rotational exercise performing windshield wipers while hanging from a bar.
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise legs to bar height.
Rotate legs to one side while keeping grip.
Sweep legs to the other side in a windshield wiper motion.
Maintain straight legs throughout.

name: full_windshield_wiper
description: An elite rotational exercise performing full-range windshield wipers while hanging.
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise legs to touch the bar.
Lower legs in a wide arc to one side.
Sweep to the other side through the full range of motion.
Maintain straight legs and control throughout.

name: dragon_flag_twist
description: A dragon flag with a rotational component, twisting the body during the lowering phase.
instructions: Grip a sturdy surface behind your head.
Raise body into a dragon flag position.
Twist the body to one side while lowering.
Return to center at the top and twist to the other side.

name: seated_knee_tuck
description: A seated compression exercise pulling the knees toward the chest.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or the floor with legs extended.
Lean back slightly, gripping the seat for support.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Extend legs back out with control.

name: boat_hold
description: An isometric V-sit position with legs and torso elevated, holding a boat shape.
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Raise bent legs to a 90-degree angle.
Hold arms parallel to the floor alongside the legs.
Maintain the position for the prescribed time.

name: v_sit_hold
description: An isometric hold in a V position with straight legs elevated.
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Raise straight legs to about 45 degrees.
Hold arms alongside the legs.
Maintain a V shape with the body.

name: pike_pulse
description: Small pulsing movements in a pike compression position to build active flexibility.
instructions: Sit in a pike position with legs straight ahead.
Place hands on the floor beside your thighs.
Press into the floor, lifting hips slightly.
Pulse up and down with small movements.

name: tuck_l_sit
description: An L-sit with knees tucked to the chest, a preparatory position for the full L-sit.
instructions: Place hands on the floor beside your hips.
Press into the floor and lift hips off the ground.
Pull knees to your chest in a tuck position.
Hold for the prescribed time.
commonMistakes: Not fully lifting off the ground.

name: l_sit_floor
description: A full L-sit performed on the floor with legs extended straight.
instructions: Place hands on the floor beside your hips, or on fists.
Press into the floor and lift hips and legs off the ground.
Extend legs straight in front, parallel to the floor.
Hold for the prescribed time.

name: l_sit
description: A full L-sit performed on parallettes, allowing greater clearance and deeper compression.
instructions: Grip parallettes with arms straight.
Press body up and extend legs straight forward.
Keep legs parallel to the floor.
Hold for the prescribed time.

name: v_sit
description: An elevated V-sit raising the legs higher than a standard L-sit.
instructions: Sit on the floor or parallettes.
Press up and raise straight legs above horizontal.
Create a V shape between torso and legs.
Hold with maximum compression.

name: jumping_jack
description: A classic cardio exercise jumping feet wide while raising arms overhead.
instructions: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides.
Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead.
Jump back to the starting position.
Maintain a steady rhythm.

name: high_knee_march
description: A low-impact cardio exercise marching in place with high knee lifts.
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Lift one knee to hip height while pumping the opposite arm.
Lower and repeat with the other leg.
Keep a steady marching pace.

name: high_knees
description: A fast-paced cardio drill running in place with knees driven high.
instructions: Run in place, driving knees to hip height.
Pump arms in sync with the legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Maintain quick turnover.

name: butt_kick
description: A cardio drill running in place while kicking heels to the glutes.
instructions: Run in place, kicking heels toward your glutes.
Keep knees pointing down.
Pump arms naturally.
Stay on the balls of your feet.

name: skater_hop
description: A lateral plyometric movement hopping side to side like a speed skater.
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Leap laterally to the other foot.
Land softly on the opposite foot, bringing the trailing leg behind.
Immediately leap back to the other side.

name: squat_thrust
description: A burpee without the jump or push-up, transitioning between standing and plank.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place hands on the floor.
Jump feet back to a plank position.
Jump feet forward and stand up.

name: burpee
description: A full-body conditioning exercise combining a squat, plank, push-up, and jump.
instructions: Stand, then squat down placing hands on the floor.
Jump feet back to a plank and perform a push-up.
Jump feet forward to the squat position.
Explode upward into a jump with arms overhead.
commonMistakes: Not achieving full hip extension on the jump.

name: tuck_jump
description: An explosive plyometric jump bringing knees to the chest at the peak.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump as high as possible, pulling knees to chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Immediately jump again.

name: burpee_pull_up
description: A burpee performed under a pull-up bar, adding a pull-up at the top of each jump.
instructions: Perform a burpee beneath a pull-up bar.
Jump and catch the bar.
Perform a pull-up.
Release and go directly into the next burpee.
commonMistakes: Poor timing on the bar catch.

name: plyometric_push_up
description: An explosive push-up where hands leave the ground at the top.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower chest to the floor.
Explode upward so hands leave the ground.
Land softly and immediately descend.

name: frog_squat
description: A deep squat mimicking a frog position, building hip mobility and lower body endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width.
Squat deep, placing hands on the floor between your feet.
Rise to standing with arms overhead.
Return to the frog position.

name: crawl_forward
description: A basic crawling exercise on hands and knees, building coordination and body awareness.
instructions: Start on all fours with knees on the ground.
Move opposite hand and knee forward simultaneously.
Crawl forward for the prescribed distance.
Keep back flat and head neutral.

name: inchworm
description: Walking the hands out from standing to a plank and back, combining flexibility with upper body engagement.
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Bend forward and walk hands out to a plank position.
Walk hands back toward feet.
Stand up and repeat.

name: monkey_walk
description: A deep squat walking movement mimicking primate locomotion.
instructions: Squat deep with hands touching the floor.
Walk forward in the squat position, using hands for light support.
Keep hips low and core engaged.
Move continuously for the prescribed time.
commonMistakes: Rising out of the deep squat.

name: scorpion_reach
description: A prone rotational movement reaching one foot toward the opposite hand behind the body.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended to the sides.
Lift one leg and rotate it over the body toward the opposite hand.
Return to start and switch sides.
Control the movement through the full range.

name: lizard_crawl
description: An advanced crawling pattern staying close to the ground with deep hip and shoulder engagement.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Step one hand and the opposite foot forward simultaneously.
Lower body close to the ground like a lizard.
Continue crawling with alternating contralateral limbs.
commonMistakes: Not getting low enough to the ground.
